generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government /Government of India / Union Territory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal.
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself.
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled.
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority.
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd: 26.04.2022.
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved.
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned.
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM)-2, KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours.
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only.
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid.
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish e-Bank Guarantee from the banks which are integrated with NeSL or DD/NEFT from Nationalised/Scheduled Bank for an amount equivalent to 5% of contract value with an appropriate validity period within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Intent (LOI). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG)/DD shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be 12 months after completing the work. The total contract period is Sixteen (16) Months (i.e. 04 months completion period & 12 months Guarantee period). The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract.

technicalCriterionList.description: PQR-2: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work such as Construction of RCC/CC Road of value not less than Rs.47.45 Lakhs in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

PQR-3: Minimum quantity: a)The intending eligible bidders as indicated in PQR (1 & 2) should have satisfactorily executed a minimum of 520.00 cum concrete work in any one year for continuous period of 12 Months in in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of the same, the work done certificate indicating the quantity executed issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/ Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Thermal Power Station in India as the case shall be uploaded.

PQR-4: Financial Turnover: The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of value not less than Rs.94.90 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)

technicalCriterionList.description: PQR-3: Minimum quantity b)The intending eligible bidders as indicated in PQR (1 & 2) should have satisfactorily executed a minimum of 19.15 tonnes reinforcement steel work in any one year for continuous period of 12 Months in in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).In proof of the same, the work done certificate indicating the quantity executed issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/ Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Thermal Power Station in India as the case shall be uploaded

PQR-3: Minimum quantity c)The intending eligible bidders as indicated in PQR (1 & 2) should have satisfactorily executed a minimum of 412.00 cum Wet Mix Macadam work in any one year for continuous period of 12 Months in in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).In proof of the same, the work done certificate indicating the quantity executed issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/ Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Thermal Power Station in India as the case shall be uploaded

technicalCriterionList.description: PQR-6: Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 24.13 Lakhs Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.,.shall be uploaded
PQR-1: Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class III & above are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded

PQR-5: Assessed available tender capacity, Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria in Para no.1, 2, 3 & 4 of PQRs, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity A x N x 2.5-B should be greater than the amount put to tender, were A is maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years updated to 2026-27 price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 04 months. B -Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 04 Months (0.33 months) (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited). Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on- going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent or self-declaration documents are to be uploaded for which Format is included in the Bid document.

The Bidders should upload the following declarations by duly signed, I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government or Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declare that EMD has not been forfeited and none of my contracts have been terminated or foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past Three years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing RCC approach road at 220/400kV ODY areas including replacement of damaged precast slabs of cable trenches at RTPS (In phased manner)

itemList.description: Removing, collecting, stacking the existing metal from Out Door Yard (ODY) area, removing the debris, waste materials, weeds including screening the metal to remove all fines, soil particle, etc, and neatly stacking at slightly shifted locations and spreading the same including all leads and lifts etc., complete as directed by Engineer in charge
Scarifying the existing bituminous road surface to a depth of 50 mm and disposal of scarified material by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator with in all lifts and lead.
Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/ by mechanical means including stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, arricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m

Loosening, leveling and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction.

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening,cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures.

Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub base, with 43 grade cement or any other type as per Clause 1501.2.2 M30 (Grade), coarse and fine aggregates conforming to IS:383, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 cum capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design, laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes, compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, , primer, sealant , curing of concrete slabs for 14- days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work. with OPC at 320 kg/cum and fly ash 40kg/cum confirming to IS-3812. (Fly ash will be issued departmentally)

Providing and fixing in position 25mm dia dowel bars precoated with anticorrosive epoxy paint of required Dia. 600 mm. Long and at 300 mm. C/C and wherever directed including handling, straightening, necessary cutting supported by TMT, chairs with proper alignment by using properly designed assembly of Bulkheads lubricating half length with bituminous paint as directed etc. complete.

Providing and laying in position M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates Cement Concrete for all Foundation works The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.
